### Selected Projects
*Full write-ups: [mcooperjay.github.io/projects](https://mcooperjay.github.io/projects/index.html)*

**NYC Rodent-Activity Risk Mapping** — Built a conditional autoregressive (CAR) model to map rodent activity across NYC city council districts, separating true infestation from reporting bias in 311 data; won the 2026 BYU Statistics Case Study Competition ([write-up](https://mcooperjay.github.io/projects/nyc-rodent-risk.html))
